general_info.subject: RFQ for global launch marketing services for new kids health drink

rfq_draft.scope_overview: Select an integrated agency partner for the global launch of a new kids health drink covering strategy, creative, TVC development and production, paid and organic social, claims compliance review, and launch governance.

buyer_priorities.title: Kids advertising compliance
buyer_priorities.description: The program must be safe for child-directed marketing and claims usage.

buyer_priorities.title: Launch speed
buyer_priorities.description: The buyer values partners who can manage approvals and hit the launch calendar.

buyer_priorities.title: Integrated delivery
buyer_priorities.description: The buyer prefers partners who can coordinate multiple launch workstreams cleanly.

mandatory_conditions: Vendors must explicitly confirm capability to support child-directed advertising and claims review.
Vendors must provide a named engagement lead and governance approach.
Vendors must quote against all applicable RFQ line items and call out exclusions clearly.
Vendors must state whether launch timelines are achievable with identified dependencies.

line_items.description: Launch strategy, audience segmentation, messaging framework, creative territory development and master campaign toolkit for a new kids health drink.
Development of flagship TV commercial concept and all pre-production creative required for global launch approvals.
End-to-end TVC shoot, post-production and delivery of master film and cutdowns for paid media use.
Organic social content strategy, monthly content calendar and asset adaptation for Meta, YouTube and TikTok.
Paid social and video media planning across Meta, YouTube and TikTok for global launch period.
Campaign trafficking, paid media activation, optimization and performance reporting across Meta, YouTube and TikTok.
Legal and regulatory review of kids advertising content and product-related claims across launch assets and scripts.
Program management, stakeholder coordination, asset trafficking and master launch governance across all workstreams.

sections.title: Mandatory gates
sections.description: Pass/fail submission and capability gates that must be satisfied before full evaluation.

sections.title: Technical evaluation
sections.description: Technical assessment of compliance safety, launch delivery, and integrated marketing execution.

sections.title: Commercial evaluation
sections.description: Commercial quote completeness, exclusions clarity, and price capture for QCBS commercial assessment.

criteria.title: Child advertising capability
criteria.description: Explicit confirmation of capability to support child-directed advertising for this launch.

evidence_checks.label: Capability confirmation
evidence_checks.description: Explicit Yes confirmation plus identification of the capability owner for child-directed advertising support.

vendor_question.text: Confirm whether your agency can support child-directed advertising for this launch. Answer Yes or No and identify the in-house team or partner capability that will perform this work.
vendor_question.purpose: Tests the mandatory requirement for child-directed advertising support capability.

deterministic_scoring.summary: Pass only where the vendor explicitly confirms capability and identifies who will perform it.

rules.condition: Answer is Yes and a specific in-house team or partner capability is identified.
Answer is No, or no specific capability owner is identified.

criteria.title: Claims review capability
criteria.description: Explicit confirmation of capability to support claims review for launch assets.

evidence_checks.label: Claims review confirmation
evidence_checks.description: Explicit Yes confirmation plus identification of the capability owner for claims review support.

vendor_question.text: Confirm whether your agency can support claims review for launch assets and product-related claims. Answer Yes or No and identify the in-house team or partner capability that will perform this work.
vendor_question.purpose: Tests the mandatory requirement for claims review support capability.

deterministic_scoring.summary: Pass only where the vendor explicitly confirms claims review capability and identifies who will perform it.

rules.condition: Answer is Yes and a specific in-house team or partner capability is identified.
Answer is No, or no specific capability owner is identified.

criteria.title: Named engagement lead
criteria.description: Submission of a named engagement lead for the launch program.

evidence_checks.label: Lead details provided
evidence_checks.description: Named engagement lead is provided with role title and contact details.

vendor_question.text: Provide the full name, role title, and email address of the named engagement lead who will own this launch program.
vendor_question.purpose: Tests the mandatory requirement to provide a named engagement lead.

deterministic_scoring.answer_format: Text fields: full name, role title, email address
deterministic_scoring.summary: Pass only where a complete named engagement lead record is submitted.

rules.condition: A full name, role title, and email address are all provided for one named engagement lead.
Any of the required lead details are missing, or no named engagement lead is provided.

criteria.title: Governance approach submitted
criteria.description: Submission of a governance approach for managing the launch program.

evidence_checks.label: Governance overview submitted
evidence_checks.description: A governance approach is explicitly provided and includes at least cadence, decision ownership, and escalation.

vendor_question.text: Confirm whether you are providing a launch governance approach. Answer Yes or No and submit a brief overview covering meeting cadence, decision ownership, and escalation.
vendor_question.purpose: Tests the mandatory requirement to provide a governance approach.

deterministic_scoring.summary: Pass only where the vendor confirms submission and provides the required governance overview.

rules.condition: Answer is Yes and a governance overview covering cadence, decision ownership, and escalation is provided.
Answer is No, or the required governance overview is not provided.

criteria.title: Timeline statement submitted
criteria.description: Submission of a clear statement on whether the buyer launch timelines are achievable, with dependencies identified.

evidence_checks.label: Timeline status declared
evidence_checks.description: A launch timeline status is selected and dependencies or constraints are listed.

vendor_question.text: State whether the buyer launch timelines are achievable. Select one option: Achievable as issued / Achievable with dependencies / Not achievable. Then list the key dependencies or constraints, or state None.
vendor_question.purpose: Tests the mandatory requirement to state timeline achievability with dependencies.

deterministic_scoring.summary: Pass only where the vendor states timeline status and identifies dependencies or explicitly states none.

rules.condition: One timeline status option is selected and dependencies or constraints are listed, or the response explicitly states None.
No valid timeline status is selected, or no dependency or constraint statement is provided.

criteria.title: Compliance delivery approach
criteria.description: Approach for keeping child-directed marketing and claims usage safe across launch asset creation, review, and approval.

evidence_checks.label: End-to-end compliance method
evidence_checks.description: A clear end-to-end method for child-directed advertising and claims compliance is described across asset development and approvals.

vendor_question.text: Describe your end-to-end approach for ensuring child-directed marketing safety and claims usage compliance across strategy, creative, TVC, social, and launch approvals. Include where reviews occur, who owns them, how issues are escalated, and how rework is prevented.
vendor_question.purpose: Assesses the critical technical risk around kids advertising compliance and claims usage safety.

criteria.qualitative_scoring_guidance: Score strongly where the response shows embedded compliance checkpoints throughout development, clear ownership, timely review sequencing, and practical escalation and rework control across all asset types. Score weakly where compliance is treated as a late legal sign-off, reviewer roles are unclear, or the method does not cover both child-directed advertising and claims usage.

criteria.title: Launch plan and approvals
criteria.description: Ability to manage approvals and deliver to the buyer launch calendar with visible dependencies and controls.

evidence_checks.label: Realistic launch workplan
evidence_checks.description: A realistic launch workplan is provided with dependencies, approval points, and actions to control schedule risk.

vendor_question.text: Provide your proposed launch workplan from kickoff to launch, showing key stages for strategy, creative, TVC, social, compliance review, and program management. Explain how approvals will be managed, what the critical dependencies are, and how schedule risks will be controlled.
vendor_question.purpose: Assesses the critical technical risk around launch speed and approval management.

criteria.qualitative_scoring_guidance: Score strongly where the plan is realistic, sequences major workstreams coherently, makes approval handling explicit, identifies critical dependencies, and includes credible actions for keeping dates on track. Score weakly where the plan is generic, omits approval management, ignores interdependencies, or relies on optimistic assumptions without controls.

criteria.title: Strategy and creative approach
criteria.description: Approach to launch strategy, audience segmentation, messaging framework, and creative territory development.

evidence_checks.label: Strategic and creative method
evidence_checks.description: A structured approach is provided for audience segmentation, messaging, and development of launch creative territories.

vendor_question.text: Describe your approach to launch strategy and creative development for the new kids health drink, including audience segmentation, messaging framework, creative territory development, and how the master campaign idea will be carried into launch assets.
vendor_question.purpose: Assesses the quality of the proposed strategy and creative development method.

criteria.qualitative_scoring_guidance: Score strongly where the response shows a clear strategic path from audience understanding to messaging and creative territories, with a coherent master campaign idea suitable for global launch. Score weakly where the response is generic, disconnected across stages, or does not show how strategy will translate into usable creative outputs.

criteria.title: TVC delivery capability
criteria.description: Approach to TVC concept development, production, post-production, and delivery of master film and cutdowns.

evidence_checks.label: TVC execution plan
evidence_checks.description: A coherent TVC execution approach is provided from concept through final film and cutdown delivery.

vendor_question.text: Describe your approach to TVC development and production for the global launch, covering concept development, pre-production, shoot management, post-production, and delivery of the master film and cutdowns for paid media use.
vendor_question.purpose: Assesses the quality of the proposed TVC development and production capability.

criteria.qualitative_scoring_guidance: Score strongly where the response shows joined-up thinking from concept to production delivery, practical control of production stages, and readiness to deliver master film and cutdowns for launch use. Score weakly where major production stages are glossed over, handoffs are unclear, or delivery outputs are not well addressed.
